description: Source code implementing NEON-optimized image convolution functions for the Skia graphics library, including horizontal and vertical convolution routines with NEON intrinsics.

methods.name: AccumRemainder
methods.description: Calculates the remainder contribution for convolution using NEON intrinsics.

methods.name: ConvolveHorizontally_Neon
methods.description: Performs horizontal convolution on a single row using NEON.

methods.name: Convolve4RowsHorizontally_Neon
methods.description: Performs horizontal convolution on four rows simultaneously using NEON.

methods.name: ConvolveVertically_Neon
methods.description: Performs vertical convolution on multiple rows using NEON.
